betaSettings.httpsDescription: Serve the FiestaBoard web UI over HTTPS using a self-signed certificate. Each FiestaBoard instance generates its own certificate on first start.

betaSettings.restartDialogDescriptionDisabled: FiestaBoard needs to restart for nginx to revert to plain HTTP. This takes about 5–10 seconds and the page will reload.
betaSettings.restartManualHint: The fiestaupdater sidecar isn't running, so we can't restart automatically. From your install directory, run: docker compose restart

systemControls.description: Manage FiestaBoard updates and host power.
systemControls.updateDialogDescription: This will pull v{version} and recreate the FiestaBoard container. The board display will pause for about 30 seconds and this page will reload automatically.
systemControls.rePullDialogDescription: This will pull the latest image for the current version and recreate the container. Useful if you want to ensure you're running the newest build of the same version.
systemControls.restartDialogDescription: This will restart the FiestaBoard container. The board display will pause for about 5–10 seconds and this page will reload automatically.
systemControls.shutdownDialogDescription: This will stop all FiestaBoard services and power off the host machine. You will need physical access (or remote SSH) to turn it back on.
systemControls.takingLongerDescription: FiestaBoard may still be restarting. Check the container logs, then refresh this page.
systemControls.shuttingDownDescription: FiestaBoard is stopping services and powering off the host. Turn the power back on to restart.

schemaForm.geoErrorUnavailableMac: Location information unavailable. On macOS, Wi-Fi must be enabled for location services to work, even if you're connected via Ethernet. Please: 1) Enable Wi-Fi in System Settings, 2) Ensure Location Services is enabled in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services, 3) Wait a few moments for location to be determined, then try again.
schemaForm.geoErrorUnavailableGeneric: Location information unavailable. This usually means your device cannot determine its location.
